acceptanceCriteria: Workspace package versions and Cargo.lock resolve to 0.2.85.
Release CI publishes an annotated v0.2.85 tag with target archives, SBOM/provenance, Formula, checksums, and matching Runtime identity.
Public adopter and N-1 acceptance use only immutable v0.2.85 and the last public v0.2.83 artifact, proving repository isolation and temporary-run cleanup.
English, Chinese, and Japanese release/versioning/parity records identify v0.2.85 and its v0.2.83 N-1 boundary.
The terminal Outcome is human-visible and records status, unknowns, evidence, human decision, and next action.
goal: Release v0.2.85 with reproducible supply-chain evidence and a human-auditable adopter acceptance boundary.
intent: Publish the next immutable release after the failed v0.2.84 tag, with the release quality gate satisfied by a terminally closed predecessor and publicly verifiable artifacts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Workspace version, annotated tag, release manifest, archive, SBOM, checksums, and Runtime identity remain bound to one reviewed commit.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run workspace package/version, release policy, manifest, and artifact identity checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only immutable public v0.2.85 and v0.2.83 artifacts are used; adopter repositories are isolated and temporary run roots are cleaned.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The immutable public v0.2.85 artifact is created only after the reviewed PR is merged and the release tag is published; the public acceptance harness records this post-release evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run post-release adopter acceptance plus the v0.2.83 to v0.2.85 N-1 harness.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The published Runtime emits a complete first-record direct_merge_no_pr receipt that its own finalize-recovery validator accepts without hand-editing generated evidence.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The direct-merge round-trip must be exercised with the downloaded public v0.2.85 binary after publication; no source or workspace binary is a substitute.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the plan-to-apply round-trip and validate the downloaded v0.2.85 binary after publication.
